objective: Retire username-based registration and ordinary login in BUKLOD Main while preserving existing username-only owners through a secure email/mobile verification migration; add opt-in monthly member contact notices, account dormancy review and audited admin controls without modifying live users or production OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only production-configured BUKLOD Main Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu (provider project labeled BUKLOD Connect) 2026-11-19: 588 profiles, including 31 username logins; 10 recorded profile mobile but zero verified auth phones and zero real Auth emails among them. Main f19fc697 advanced after branch point with unrelated church-role RPC security hotfix. No user account, auth trigger, DB migration, notifier or OTA in this branch has been deployed to production.
chosenApproach: Isolated DEV source in draft PR; mobile/email-only new client registration plus prepared Auth old-client insert guard, explicit temporary legacy login recovery, owner password reauth and one-time email/SMS code, Auth existing UID contact update, protected profile reconciliation, private audit, disabled-by-default monthly in-app and external notices, admin hold/release. Preserve existing voluntary deletion flow and all reward/finance data.
selectionRationale: Immediate disabling of all username credentials would lock 31 real legacy members out; they have no verified external contact. A migration wizard preserves UID, account ownership and recovery, while disabled external notifications prevent accidental paid SMS or false 180-day notice claims.
alternativeApproaches: Hard block all username sign-ins immediately (rejected: strands existing members with no verified external recovery channel).
Accept username indefinitely as new signup method (rejected: perpetuates unreachable accounts and identity risk).
Auto convert old usernames using a profile mobile without OTP (rejected: zero verified phones and account takeover risk).
preserveBehaviors: Preserve signed-in existing member access, BUKLOD Official protection, current user IDs, posts, chats, points, referrals, pending payouts, profile usernames used as display/search handles, and current notification/recovery semantics.
Preserve Supabase main Auth onboarding triggers and existing email verification and member-ID verification policies; verify interactions before RC.
Keep ads, Wall, Connect, navigation responsiveness, all existing Season 1 and locked Season 2 reward business rules intact.
No production OTA, live database migration, real email/SMS send, paid provider activation or account deletion from this draft branch.
acceptanceChecks: Source test contracts for old-client username signup restriction, mobile/email default, temporary legacy sign-in, and same UID contact migration pass.
Production-equivalent DB test validates private RLS, server-only migration RPCs, account hold, disabled-by-default notifications and Auth trigger interactions.

Real 6-digit email/SMS OTP delivery and ownership, timeout, max attempts, collisions, network interruption, no-verified-contact legacy recovery and password reauthentication must be independently validated.
Monthly admin and member notice work only after audited opt-in policy and actual provider configuration; provider acceptance never counts as confirmed delivery for 180-day deletion clock.
Exact main security hotfix after baseRef is preserved and CI TypeScript+Node+database source gates green before production-ready RC.
Standalone production auth/backend rollout must follow verified RC; no Season 2 or unrelated OTA changes.
